observations.behavior: Implements a custom hook that uses ResizeObserver to track the bottom position of a sticky bar, accounting for its pinned top position and its height. It also observes the parent container to account for breakpoint changes.
observations.posthog_connection: Provides a calculated offset for other sticky elements to position themselves correctly below the SceneStickyBar, preventing overlap or gaps when the bar is pinned.
